about: Text the app derives from the media items, for an embedding model that reads text only (EMBEDDING_MEDIA empty): the scan read by OCR (anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5), each photo's first-pass title and description (anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5, the lines worker._describe indexes) and each recording's speech to text lines (elevenlabs/scribe-v2), all on OpenRouter's zero-retention route with the app's own requests on 2026-11-22. The tone has no words. Recorded once; regenerate rather than edit.

text.aleppo_checkpoint.png:
Barriers and defaced portrait billboard on street
حواجز إسمنتية ولوحة إعلانية مشوهة على الطريق
Concrete barriers painted with red, white and green stars and stripes line the road on the left.
A billboard portrait of a man in a suit has its face scratched or smeared with green paint.
Arabic script in white on the billboard reads a greeting phrase.
A small roofed booth and a corrugated metal wall stand behind the barriers.
A watermark logo appears in the lower right corner.
text.aleppo_souk.jpg:
Damaged covered market arcade with rubble
ممر سوق مغطى متضرر مع أنقاض
Arched stone covered market passage with large holes in the vaulted roof and daylight coming through.
Piles of collapsed stone blocks and rubble line the right side of the passage.
Damaged shutters and a corrugated metal shutter on the left side, with debris on the ground.
Several people walk through the passage; two men stand on the left and a woman walks in the centre.
A man on the left is raising a phone to take a photograph.
text.speech.wav:
صباح الخير.
هي رسالة صوتية قصيرة عن رحلة الأسبوع الجاي عالساحل.
راح ننطلق من كراج الباصات الساعة 7 الصبح.
جيبوا معكم جاكيت خفيف لأنه الجو برد جنب البحر.
راح نوقف بضيعة صغيرة لنشتري زيتون وجبنة بلدية.
بعد الغدا راح نزور القلعة القديمة وبعدين نتمشى عالبحر.
الكل راح يرجع عالمدينة قبل نص الليل.
